scope: P1 product feature backend closure for core navigation pages

pages.goal: 让用户从医保审计专题进入生产流程：项目选择、数据导入、规则运行、疑点复核、归档和整改。
acceptance: create or select one audit project
open one finding and review it
implemented_first_batch: select SELF-CHECK-FUND-20260607 from GET /api/v1/projects with medical topic fallback
render project status, workflow steps, queue and member workload from GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/dashboard
keep audit findings visible when project dashboard is unavailable
leave production write actions behind confirmation gate

pages.goal: 把所有一级/二级知识库分类、文档数、片段数、最后同步和数据来源口径讲清楚。
acceptance: every product category maps to source_collection
metrics show document count and chunk count
implemented_first_batch: individual knowledge base detail links pass source_collection to /documents and /chat
active product category exposes a /documents link with all mapped source_collection parameters
document and chunk metric line remains read-only

pages.goal: 完成检索、引用预览、上传治理和索引状态的用户闭环。
implemented_first_batch: read source_collection from URL when opened from /knowledge-base
show current search scope in the document search status line
pass sourceCollections to document search and source_collections to AI+ query
selected citation keeps source_collection when joining /chat

pages.goal: 不引入图数据库，复用现有知识库、规则、疑点、报告数据生成只读关系图。
acceptance: filters do not require mock data
implemented_first_batch: render GET /api/v1/graph/workbench through the replica graph adapter when available
preserve node href, description, sourceCollection and domain from graph workbench responses
accept source_collection URL context from /knowledge-base and keep it in /documents and /chat downstream links
show backend seed/fallback state through the runtime badge instead of hiding data provenance

pages.goal: 模型、知识库范围、附件和智能体上下文进入同一个 query payload，并返回引用与调用状态。
acceptance: model unavailable returns clear status without history write
attachments produce analysis or summary result
implemented_first_batch: model, source_collections and agent are sent together in POST /api/v1/query
question, source_collection and agent URL parameters hydrate the chat composer
@ and / commands both select an agent before submission
assistant answers show model status, effective source collections, fallback state, citations and query log id
attachment analysis uses POST /api/v1/chat/attachments/analyze with selected model when available

execution_batches.focus: graph readonly relation view and chat contextual payload
